authority_rules: Two authenticated seats; each controls exactly five owned champions; team cannot come from command body
Per-seat sequence is a positive safe integer, with previous receipt saved and rebound after room restore
Idempotency canonical key includes selected unitId, kind and payload; replayed packet reuses the original ACK
Changed payload or selected unit using an existing sequence must reject without mutation
Out-of-order packet rejection does not consume sequence or alter snapshot
Only server can mutate gold, inventory and shop eligibility; client-provided team/gold rejected
Once seat is ready, new purchases are denied; previously committed retry still returns old ACK
Room authoritative snapshot stores RNG, tokens hashes and receipts; transport never sends those fields to either seat
Both teams have separate command sequence spaces, while global order of commits determines journal and full digest
Opponent inventory, gold, effect internals and private intents never leak via seat projection
Defender-only pending decision is included only in defender view; untrusted projection mutations never alter server state

core-protocol: seat auth and five owned units
core-replay: persist arena snapshot + gateway receipt session atomically
globally ordered actions and deterministic restore
core-items: item state remains server-owned and private
P1 legacy trinket route repair as explicitly declared deviation
core-state: absolute simulation clocks, RNG, hidden world state, ordered journal
game-server: strict separation between internal checkpoint and public SSE

acceptance_gates: Rust native tests for blue/red and all five champions
Post-restore original ACK identical, state hash unchanged
Transport-level HTTP/SSE and cookie-origin tests REQUIRED separately
Durable checkpoint test REQUIRED separately (not certified by B11 V8)
Never certify G8 based on source V8-only tests
